findings.body: This previously reported gap remains open: the branch adds a generated `.factory` review/task-state record even though the declared scope permits only the listed backend financial-data files, `backend/package.json`, and the quality-gate test. The file is not needed for drill issuance or its tests and contains transient review and commit metadata, so it should be removed from this change.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope Forge task-state file
